Scenario fixture: heading-quality

Each target has a stable id of the form hq_case_NN. Headings with no accessible name at all belong to empty-heading and are not repeated here.

A. Descriptive headings

01 — PASS: heading naming its topic

Opening hours

We are open Monday through Friday from 10 to 16.

02 — PASS: single character heading over a glossary (short is not a signal)

A

airplane
a powered flying vehicle with fixed wings.
03 — PASS: placeholder word inside a real phrase (exact match only)

Heading into the storm season

Preparations for the coming months.

04 — PASS: role=heading named by aria-label
Delivery options

Standard and express delivery are available.

Heading

We are open Monday through Friday from 10 to 16.

Section 2
